name: TwistingData.degree_le_of_coeff_frobOperator
summary: frobOperator_mem for the Gauss filtration over the 0-adic filtration with weight −1 on the variables of letter j and 0 elsewhere.

steps.claim: Apply frobOperator_mem with the Gauss filtration (weight −1 on the variables of letter j, 0 on the others) over the trivial filtration, α = 0, x = 0 and u = P^ℓ (the entries of frobGenericMatrix are P^d-th powers of variables, d ≤ ℓ, at level ≥ −P^ℓ): the entry lies at level −N·n·k(ℓ+2)P^ℓ, so a monomial x^ν with nonzero coefficient has letter-j degree at most N·n·k(ℓ+2)P^ℓ (otherwise its coefficient would be divisible by a positive power of 0).
steps.lean:
rify; simpa [degree_eq_sum] using (mt zero_pow (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero e (T.frobOperator_mem
    (gaussFiltration _ (if ·.1 = j then -1 else 0)) 0 0 _ (by simp) (by simp) (fun s d h _ _ ↦
    antitone (by grw [← h] <;> bound [T.prime.pos]) (pow_mem_graded _ X_mem_gaussFiltration)) ..)))
